# License-text provenance

`react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8` declares MIT in its published package, but
omits the license file. Its published npm `gitHead` is not available in the
upstream GitHub repository. The accompanying text is copied verbatim from
the upstream author's [license addition](https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/7301c160fda44cb8cf2b9fdfde61efad35736196/LICENSE),
not reconstructed from a template. It supplements the package's declared
license; it does not claim that commit is the package's source revision.

The packager uses this explicitly version-scoped fallback. All other missing
dependency license texts fail packaging rather than being silently omitted.
